subject: CAIQ: control fingerprint, scope clarifications and evidence inventory
messages:
From: Simone Hart <simone.hart@aureum-fin.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@aureum-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-06T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: CAIQ intake - initial control fingerprint questions

Irene,

Thanks for the quick intake form you sent earlier. We're digging into Redwood's CAIQ responses as part of our vendor risk assessment and have a couple of clarifying asks before we move to evidence collection:

1) Scope: can you confirm whether the CAIQ submission should be scoped to the hosted Redwood API only, or whether we should expect evidence for Dedicated and Private deployments (we're particularly interested in Private/VPC options)?

2) Control fingerprinting: for a handful of controls (notably CCM-IA-03 and CCM-EP-02) we would like a short mapping — one or two lines — that points to the runtime artifacts you plan to provide (e.g., audit log paths, sample log lines, configuration screenshots).

3) Timeline: our intake window for the current quarter closes on 2026-06-21. If you can provide an evidence index (spreadsheet with owner + artifact name + link) by 2026-06-10, that would keep us on schedule.

If easier, happy to take a short call — but a scoped index + a couple sample artifacts would let us validate quickly.

Thanks,
Simone Hart
Security Program Manager
Aureum Financial
simone.hart@aureum-fin.com

---
Attachment: (none)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Simone Hart <simone.hart@aureum-fin.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-06T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake - initial control fingerprint questions

Hi Simone — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers first, then action items: 

Scope: Primary scope is Hosted API. We can include Dedicated artifacts on request and provide Private (VPC/on-prem) *narrative* plus representative operational controls; full Private evidence (customer-managed infra) is typically limited to configuration examples and playbooks.

Fingerprinting: We can provide concise mappings for the controls you called out. For example: 
- CCM-IA-03 (Identity lifecycle): owner = kimberly.park@redwood.com; artifact = IAM-rotation-policy.pdf; runtime proof = auth-server-rotate.log (sample).
- CCM-EP-02 (Edge protection / inference perimeter): owner = marissa.cole@redwood.com; artifact = ingress-waf-policy.json; runtime proof = edge-conn-trace.txt (sample).

Timeline: We can deliver an evidence index by 2026-06-10. Marissa will assemble an attachment with owner/filename/link + brief control notes. Jonas will add any runtime log sample we can sanitize.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa: compile the CAIQ index workbook and flag artifacts that are Private-only vs Hosted/Dedicated.
- Jonas: extract 1-2 sanitized log snippets (no PII, remove tenant ids) for CCM-EP-02 and CCM-OP-04.
- Kimberly: confirm IAM artifact names and whether we can provide a signed attestation for rotation timelines.

Simone — I'll send the index as an attachment once Marissa uploads it. If you need a short (20m) sync before the 10th, propose times and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

---
Attachment: (none)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Simone Hart <simone.hart@aureum-fin.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ control index + sample artifacts (initial delivery)

Hi Simone,

Attached is the first pass of the CAIQ control index you requested. High-level notes are below; the workbook has a "control_notes" tab with one-line fingerprints per CSA control.

Key artifacts attached in this message (stubs):
- CAIQ_ControlIndex_v1.xlsx (workbook) — columns: control_id, redwood_response, artifact_name, artifact_owner, artifact_type, access_link, notes
- runtime_log_snippet.txt — sanitized token of an edge connection trace used for CCM-EP-02 validation
- redwood_control_mapping_snapshot.pdf — short narrative showing where Hosted vs Dedicated evidence differs

Representative fingerprints (examples from the workbook):
- CCM-IA-03: "Rotation policy + IAM audit logs (sample). Owner: Kimberly Park. Artifact: IAM-Rotation-Policy-v2.pdf. Sample: iam-rotate-20260512.log"
- CCM-EP-02: "Ingress/WAF config + edge connection trace. Owner: Marissa Cole. Artifact: ingress-waf-policy.json. Sample: runtime_log_snippet.txt"
- CCM-OP-04: "Agent telemetry retention proof (logs + exporter config). Owner: Jonas Weber. Artifact: telemetry-exporter.conf. Note: we include a 7-day sanitized sample."

Access model: most artifacts are in a secure shared-drive folder. If you need docs through a vendor portal or a signed NDA-first bundle, let us know. The workbook has an "access_requirements" column per artifact.

Next steps:
- Simone: confirm whether the Hosted-only scope works or if you need Dedicated artifacts included in the first bundle.
- Kimberly: will confirm the IAM attestation availability by EOD 2026-06-08.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachments: CAIQ_ControlIndex_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), runtime_log_snippet.txt (text), redwood_control_mapping_snapshot.pdf (pdf)
From: Simone Hart <simone.hart@aureum-fin.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@aureum-fin.com
Date: 2026-06-08T15:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control index + sample artifacts (initial delivery)

Marissa/Irene — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround. The indexed workbook and the runtime snippet are exactly what we needed for the triage pass. A few quick notes: 

- Hosted-only scope is fine for our initial assessment. We will request Dedicated/Private artifacts later if we move to procurement.
- The access model in the workbook is acceptable, but we need a DocuSign signature for the attestation language on rotation policies before we record the control as "validated" in our portal. Can you route a short attestation for CCM-IA-03 (rotation) and CCM-EP-02 (edge protection) to my manager?
- The runtime_log_snippet looks sanitized; once we receive the signed attestation we can move this into our evidence repository.

If you can send the attestation via DocuSign by 2026-06-11 we'll stay on our internal timeline. Otherwise we'll flag the control as pending and may need a short follow-up call.

Thanks again — will follow up from our side after the attestation.

Best,
Simone Hart
Security Program Manager
Aureum Financial
simone.hart@aureum-fin.com
